_comment: SEIS VPN ACL example for NetBird. Each team and partner company is a group; rules grant least-privilege access between groups. Apply via the NetBird management API or dashboard. No secrets here.

policies.name: core-full-internal
policies.description: Core operators reach all internal servers

policies.name: dev-ssh-only
policies.description: Developers reach internal servers over SSH only

policies.name: company-scoped
policies.description: Each partner company is isolated to its own group; no cross-company or internal access by default
